title: Inventory Manager
description: Save, manage and restore your inventory kits easily!
body:
![Release 🔰](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f81a23ee84d02331bfd1b22de1e2da2fe562b549_0.webp)
**Inventory Manager** is a lightweight and powerful utility mod for Fabric that allows you to save your current inventory state and restore it whenever you need. Whether you are a creative builder testing different sets or a player who needs quick equipment swaps, this mod provides a clean and intuitive interface for all your needs. 🛠️
―――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

✨**Main Features:**

• 💾 **Create Custom Loadouts**
Save your entire inventory including armor slots and off-hand item with a single click. Just press the plus button, enter a name, and your kit is ready.

• 🔍 **Visual Preview**
Not sure what is inside a saved kit? Use the preview icon to see the full layout of items without actually loading them. This includes a clear view of the main inventory, hotbar, and armor slots.

• ⚙️ **Smart Management**
You can easily rename your kits to keep things organized or delete old ones you no longer need. There is also a quick option to clear the entire list if you want to start fresh.

• 🌍**Seamless Integration**
The mod automatically detects your game language. It features full support for both English and Russian, ensuring a native experience for all players.

**_To change the language, go to the game settings_**

―――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

⌨️ **Interactive Tooltips and Shortcuts:**

✅ **Load Inventory:** Click the check mark to instantly apply a saved set to your character. The menu will close automatically.

⏹️ **Preview:** Use the stop button icon (square) to peek inside a kit. View all items, armor, and Shulker Box contents without loading them.

✏️ **Rename:** Click the pencil to change the name of an existing loadout.

⬆️ **Export:** Use the up arrow to copy a kit's encrypted data to your clipboard. Share it with friends!

⌨️ **Key Bindings:** Click the brackets [-], then press any key to bind that kit. Load it instantly in-game by pressing that key! (Use ESC or Backspace to clear).

❎ **Delete:** Use the square X icon to permanently remove a specific kit from your list.

⬇️ **Import:** Use the down arrow at the bottom to paste and save a kit code received from another player.

🗑️ **Clear All:** The trash can in the corner wipes your entire collection. **_Warning: This cannot be undone!_**

―――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

💻 **Technical Details:**
The mod saves your data in a dedicated folder within your game config, meaning your kits are safe even if you update the mod.

Works perfectly in Creative Mode for instant item restoration.

Includes a stylish gradient background for the menu, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the game world. ✨

👑 Created by PrestigeX
